guestExploreJoin.title: Can't join from Explore with this account
guestExploreJoin.messageDefault: This account type can't join servers from the public Explore directory. Create a free Echo account with email to join listed communities, or use an invite link from a member.
guestExploreJoin.messageWithHint:
{hint}

To join listed servers from the directory, create a free Echo account with email (upgrade from your profile or the guest banner). You can still join a community if someone sends you an invite link.
